title: Three Ways to Say No
label: ch:bn-three-ways-to-say-no
canDo: I can deny any sentence this book has taught me — one negator for a sentence with a verb, one for a sentence without, one for a thing that is not there — and I can turn every one of them into a yes-or-no question without moving a word.

payoff.summary: Three negators and one question shape, run against frames the book has been teaching since chapter three: the name frame denied with নয়, the verb denied with না, the missing thing denied with নেই, and each of the three asked back with a rising voice.
payoff.note: The chapter's payoff is that every affirmative frame already in the book becomes two more sentences — a denial and a question — with no new vocabulary.
